skills.name: Writing about an environmental event; dos and don'ts

note.text:
Environmental events: World Environment Day (5 June), tree-planting days, clean-up campaigns. To write about one: what it is and when; what people do; why it matters; your opinion.
A list of dos and don'ts gives short instructions in the imperative: Do plant trees. Don't burn bushes. Begin each item with the verb; keep the items short and parallel.

worked_example.problem: Plan a text on World Environment Day and a list of dos and don'ts.
steps: What and when: World Environment Day, {5} June every year.
What people do: plant trees, clean streets, talks in schools.
Why it matters: reminds us to protect nature.
Dos: Plant trees. Save water. Don'ts: Don't burn bushes. Don't throw plastic in rivers.
worked_example.answer: event: what, when, activities, importance → list of dos and don'ts

cards.idea: Say what the event is, when, and what people do.
example: World Environment Day is on {5} June.
It reminds us to protect nature.

cards.idea: Dos and don'ts start with an imperative.
example: Do plant trees. Don't burn bushes.

items.text: World Environment Day is celebrated every year on 5 June.
On that day, pupils plant trees and clean the streets.
The day reminds us that we must protect nature.
Do plant trees. Don't burn bushes.

paper_task.prompt: In your exercise book, write a paragraph (about 100 words) on an environmental event, then a list of five dos and five don'ts for protecting the environment.
model:
World Environment Day is celebrated every year on 5 June. In our school, the Environment Club organises a march, and every class plants trees around the compound. In the afternoon, a forester explains why forests matter. This day is important because it reminds everyone that the environment is our common home.

Dos: Plant trees. Put rubbish in a bin. Save water. Switch off lights you do not need. Walk short distances.
Don'ts: Don't burn bushes. Don't throw plastic into rivers. Don't cut young trees. Don't block the gutters. Don't waste water.
checklist: I said what the event is and when.
My dos and don'ts begin with a verb.
